description: fabricated customer intent: invented dissatisfaction and a wish to switch plans

email.subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – order confirmation email
email.body_text:
Hi Neha,

Thank you for your time on our call. You told us you were unhappy with the product and wanted to switch to a different plan, and that you needed your confirmation emails working urgently. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product, and you confirmed the email arrived in your inbox after your test order.

What we covered:
- We explained that the email still shows the default sender name, which can be changed in Email settings under Sender name.

Your next steps:
1. Change the sender name to your brand name (you mentioned you planned to do this after the call).

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-01

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
